biotools.summary: BioProtIS is a pipeline for streamlining protein-ligand interaction analysis, integrating molecular dynamics and docking to automate workflows at genomic and transcriptomic scales. It leverages open-source tools to facilitate docking and incorporates modular design for user customization.
